items.question: Trong câu "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", từ "real-world" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", what does "real-world" (adjective) mean?
options: thực tế, dùng trong đời thực
optionsEn: used in practice, not just in theory
items.explanation: real-world /ˌriːl ˈwɝːld/ (tính từ): thực tế, dùng trong đời thực. A real-world application = ứng dụng chạy thật với người dùng thật.
items.explanationEn: real-world /ˌriːl ˈwɝːld/ (adjective): used in practice, not just in theory. A real-world application runs in practice with real users.

items.question: Trong câu "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", từ "load" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", what does "load" (noun) mean?
options: tải (lượng truy cập/công việc hệ thống phải xử lý)
optionsEn: the amount of work or traffic a system handles
items.explanation: load /loʊd/ (danh từ): tải (lượng truy cập/công việc hệ thống phải xử lý). Variable load = lượng truy cập thay đổi lúc ít lúc nhiều. Load balancer = bộ cân bằng tải.
items.explanationEn: load /loʊd/ (noun): the amount of work or traffic a system handles. Variable load means traffic goes up and down. A load balancer spreads that load.

items.question: Trong câu "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", từ "failures" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", what does "failures" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a breakdown; when something stops working
items.explanation: failure /ˈfeɪ.ljɚ/ (danh từ): sự cố, hỏng hóc. Infrastructure failures = sự cố hạ tầng (server hoặc cả AZ bị sập). Động từ: fail.
items.explanationEn: failure /ˈfeɪ.ljɚ/ (noun): a breakdown; when something stops working. Infrastructure failures are breakdowns of servers or a whole AZ. Verb: fail.

items.question: Trong câu "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", từ "entire" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real-world application must handle variable load and infrastructure failures (a server or an entire AZ dying).", what does "entire" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: entire /ɪnˈtaɪr/ (tính từ): toàn bộ, cả. An entire AZ = cả một Availability Zone. Trạng từ: entirely.
items.explanationEn: entire /ɪnˈtaɪr/ (adjective): whole; complete. An entire AZ is a whole Availability Zone. Adverb: entirely.

optionsEn: to find an answer to a problem
items.explanation: solve /sɑːlv/ (động từ): giải quyết. Solve this = giải quyết vấn đề tải và sự cố. Danh từ: solution.
items.explanationEn: solve /sɑːlv/ (verb): to find an answer to a problem. Solve this means handling the load and failure problem. Noun: solution.

items.question: Trong câu "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", từ "distributes" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", what does "distributes" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to spread or share out among several
items.explanation: distribute /dɪˈstrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): phân phối, chia ra. ELB distributes traffic = chia lưu lượng cho nhiều target. Danh từ: distribution.
items.explanationEn: distribute /dɪˈstrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to spread or share out among several. ELB distributes traffic by spreading it over many targets. Noun: distribution.

items.question: Trong câu "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", từ "containers" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", what does "containers" (noun) mean?
options: container (gói ứng dụng chạy độc lập)
optionsEn: a packaged, isolated unit that runs an app
items.explanation: container /kənˈteɪ.nɚ/ (danh từ): container (gói ứng dụng chạy độc lập). Trong IT, container là gói ứng dụng kèm môi trường chạy (vd. Docker).
items.explanationEn: container /kənˈteɪ.nɚ/ (noun): a packaged, isolated unit that runs an app. In IT, a container packages an app with its runtime (e.g. Docker).

items.question: Trong câu "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", từ "fault tolerance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", what does "fault tolerance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the ability to keep working when parts fail
items.explanation: fault tolerance /fɑːlt ˈtɑː.lɚ.əns/ (danh từ): khả năng chịu lỗi. Fault tolerance = hệ thống vẫn chạy khi một phần bị hỏng. Tính từ: fault-tolerant.
items.explanationEn: fault tolerance /fɑːlt ˈtɑː.lɚ.əns/ (noun): the ability to keep working when parts fail. Fault tolerance means the system survives part failures. Adjective: fault-tolerant.

items.question: Trong câu "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", từ "horizontal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ELB distributes traffic to multiple targets (EC2, containers, IPs) across multiple AZs → improves fault tolerance and enables horizontal scaling.", what does "horizontal" (adjective) mean?
options: theo chiều ngang (tăng số lượng máy)
theo chiều dọc (tăng sức mạnh một máy)
items.explanation: horizontal /ˌhɔːr.əˈzɑːn.t̬əl/ (tính từ): theo chiều ngang (tăng số lượng máy). Horizontal scaling = thêm instance; vertical scaling = nâng cấu hình một instance.
items.explanationEn: horizontal /ˌhɔːr.əˈzɑːn.t̬əl/ (adjective): by adding more machines. Horizontal scaling adds instances; vertical scaling upgrades one instance.

items.question: Trong câu "ASG automatically adds/removes instances based on load → elasticity while maintaining availability.", từ "elasticity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ASG automatically adds/removes instances based on load → elasticity while maintaining availability.", what does "elasticity" (noun) mean?
options: tính co giãn (tự tăng/giảm tài nguyên)
optionsEn: ability to grow or shrink resources automatically
items.explanation: elasticity /ˌiː.læsˈtɪs.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): tính co giãn (tự tăng/giảm tài nguyên). Elasticity = tự thêm/bớt instance theo tải. Tính từ: elastic.
items.explanationEn: elasticity /ˌiː.læsˈtɪs.ə.t̬i/ (noun): ability to grow or shrink resources automatically. Elasticity means adding or removing instances with load. Adjective: elastic.

items.question: Trong câu "ASG automatically adds/removes instances based on load → elasticity while maintaining availability.", từ "maintaining" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ASG automatically adds/removes instances based on load → elasticity while maintaining availability.", what does "maintaining" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep something at the same level
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì, giữ vững. Maintaining availability = giữ cho hệ thống luôn sẵn sàng. Danh từ: maintenance.
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep something at the same level. Maintaining availability keeps the system available. Noun: maintenance.

items.question: Trong câu "This is one of the most heavily tested topics in SAA-C03.", từ "heavily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is one of the most heavily tested topics in SAA-C03.", what does "heavily" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: to a great degree; a lot
items.explanation: heavily /ˈhev.əl.i/ (trạng từ): nhiều, ở mức độ lớn. Most heavily tested = được hỏi nhiều nhất trong đề thi.
items.explanationEn: heavily /ˈhev.əl.i/ (adverb): to a great degree; a lot. Most heavily tested means asked about the most often.

items.question: Trong câu "Questions are usually scenario-based: which load balancer type, how to auto scale.", từ "scenario-based" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Questions are usually scenario-based: which load balancer type, how to auto scale.", what does "scenario-based" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scenario-based /səˈner.i.oʊ beɪst/ (tính từ): dựa trên tình huống. Scenario-based questions = câu hỏi mô tả một tình huống thực tế rồi yêu cầu chọn giải pháp.
items.explanationEn: scenario-based /səˈner.i.oʊ beɪst/ (adjective): built around a described situation. Scenario-based questions describe a situation and ask for a solution.

items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick memory hook: ALB = HTTP layer 7, NLB = TCP layer 4 + static IP, ASG = elasticity.", what does "hook" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a short trick that helps you remember
items.explanation: hook /hʊk/ (danh từ): mẹo/điểm móc để dễ nhớ. Memory hook = câu ngắn giúp ghi nhớ nhanh.
items.explanationEn: hook /hʊk/ (noun): a short trick that helps you remember. A memory hook is a short phrase that makes something easy to remember.

items.question: Trong câu "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", từ "vertical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", what does "vertical" (adjective) mean?
options: theo chiều dọc (tăng sức mạnh một máy)
optionsEn: by making a single machine more powerful
items.explanation: vertical /ˈvɝː.t̬ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): theo chiều dọc (tăng sức mạnh một máy). Vertical scaling = nâng cấu hình một instance (vd. t2.micro → m5.large).
items.explanationEn: vertical /ˈvɝː.t̬ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): by making a single machine more powerful. Vertical scaling upgrades one instance (e.g. t2.micro → m5.large).

items.question: Trong câu "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", từ "bounded" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", what does "bounded" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: bounded by /ˈbaʊn.dɪd baɪ/ (cụm từ): bị giới hạn bởi. Bounded by hardware limits = bị giới hạn bởi phần cứng. Trái nghĩa: unbounded.
items.explanationEn: bounded by /ˈbaʊn.dɪd baɪ/ (phrase): limited by. Bounded by hardware limits means the hardware sets the limit. Opposite: unbounded.

items.question: Trong câu "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", từ "restart" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", what does "restart" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: starting something again after stopping it
items.explanation: restart /ˈriː.stɑːrt/ (danh từ): sự khởi động lại. Vertical scaling thường cần restart (khởi động lại) instance.
items.explanationEn: restart /ˈriː.stɑːrt/ (noun): starting something again after stopping it. Vertical scaling usually needs the instance to be restarted.

items.question: Trong câu "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", từ "suited" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vertical scaling: bounded by hardware limits and usually requires a restart. Suited to non-distributed databases.", what does "suited" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: suited to /ˈsuː.t̬ɪd tuː/ (cụm từ): phù hợp với. Suited to non-distributed databases = phù hợp với cơ sở dữ liệu không phân tán. Đồng nghĩa: suitable for.
items.explanationEn: suited to /ˈsuː.t̬ɪd tuː/ (phrase): appropriate for. Suited to non-distributed databases means appropriate for them. Synonym: suitable for.

items.question: Trong câu "Horizontal scaling: theoretically unbounded, suited to distributed systems / web tiers.", từ "theoretically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Horizontal scaling: theoretically unbounded, suited to distributed systems / web tiers.", what does "theoretically" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in theory, not necessarily in practice
items.explanation: theoretically /ˌθiː.əˈret.ɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): về mặt lý thuyết. Theoretically unbounded = về lý thuyết không giới hạn. Danh từ: theory.
items.explanationEn: theoretically /ˌθiː.əˈret.ɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): in theory, not necessarily in practice. Theoretically unbounded means unlimited in theory. Noun: theory.

items.question: Trong câu "Horizontal scaling: theoretically unbounded, suited to distributed systems / web tiers.", từ "unbounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Horizontal scaling: theoretically unbounded, suited to distributed systems / web tiers.", what does "unbounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unbounded /ʌnˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): không giới hạn. Unbounded = không có giới hạn trên; trái nghĩa bounded.
items.explanationEn: unbounded /ʌnˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): without limits. Unbounded means having no upper limit; opposite: bounded.

items.question: Trong câu "Horizontal scaling handles load; multi-AZ handles failure. ELB + ASG combine both.", từ "combine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Horizontal scaling handles load; multi-AZ handles failure. ELB + ASG combine both.", what does "combine" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to join two or more things together
items.explanation: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (động từ): kết hợp. ELB + ASG combine both = kết hợp cả hai (xử lý tải và sự cố). Danh từ: combination.
items.explanationEn: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (verb): to join two or more things together. ELB + ASG combine both, handling load and failure. Noun: combination.

items.question: Trong câu "ELB is a managed service. Core functions: distribute traffic, perform health checks.", từ "functions" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: a job or purpose something performs
items.explanation: function /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): chức năng. Core functions = các chức năng cốt lõi của ELB.
items.explanationEn: function /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a job or purpose something performs. Core functions are ELB's main jobs.

items.question: Trong câu "Provide a single endpoint (DNS name) for the application.", từ "endpoint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Provide a single endpoint (DNS name) for the application.", what does "endpoint" (noun) mean?
options: điểm truy cập (địa chỉ để kết nối)
items.explanation: endpoint /ˈend.pɔɪnt/ (danh từ): điểm truy cập (địa chỉ để kết nối). A single endpoint = một địa chỉ DNS duy nhất để client gọi đến.
items.explanationEn: endpoint /ˈend.pɔɪnt/ (noun): an address clients connect to. A single endpoint is one DNS address that clients call.

items.question: Trong câu "Handle SSL/TLS termination, separating public and private traffic.", từ "termination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handle SSL/TLS termination, separating public and private traffic.", what does "termination" (noun) mean?

items.explanation: termination /ˌtɝː.məˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): điểm kết thúc/giải mã kết nối mã hóa. SSL/TLS termination = load balancer giải mã HTTPS thay cho backend.
items.explanationEn: termination /ˌtɝː.məˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): ending an encrypted connection and decrypting it. SSL/TLS termination means the load balancer decrypts HTTPS for the backend.

items.question: Trong câu "ALB, NLB, GWLB (modern) and CLB (legacy, not recommended for new systems).", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old, from an earlier generation. Legacy means old technology still around but not recommended. As a noun it also means inheritance.

items.question: Trong câu "ALB, NLB, GWLB (modern) and CLB (legacy, not recommended for new systems).", từ "recommended" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to advise as a good choice

items.explanationEn: recommend /ˌrek.əˈmend/ (verb): to advise as a good choice. Not recommended means advised against. Noun: recommendation.

items.question: Trong câu "An ELB can be internet-facing (public) or internal (private, VPC-only).", từ "internet-facing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

options: hướng ra Internet, truy cập công khai
items.explanation: internet-facing /ˈɪn.t̬ɚ.net ˌfeɪ.sɪŋ/ (tính từ): hướng ra Internet, truy cập công khai. Internet-facing ELB nhận traffic từ Internet; internal ELB chỉ trong VPC.
items.explanationEn: internet-facing /ˈɪn.t̬ɚ.net ˌfeɪ.sɪŋ/ (adjective): reachable from the public internet. An internet-facing ELB receives public traffic; an internal one stays inside the VPC.

items.explanationEn: routing /ˈraʊ.t̬ɪŋ/ (noun): choosing where network traffic is sent. Path-based routing sends traffic based on the URL path. Verb: route.

items.explanationEn: header /ˈhed.ɚ/ (noun): metadata fields sent with an HTTP request. HTTP headers carry info such as Host, User-Agent, cookies...

items.explanationEn: query string /ˈkwɪr.i strɪŋ/ (noun): the parameters after ? in a URL. An example query string is ?page=2&sort=asc.

items.explanationEn: redirect /ˈriː.də.rekt/ (noun): sending a request to a different address. An HTTP → HTTPS redirect sends users to the secure version.

items.explanationEn: client /ˈklaɪ.ənt/ (noun): the device or app that sends requests. Client info is data about the requester, such as its original IP.

items.question: Trong câu "Connection draining / Deregistration delay", từ "draining" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: letting existing connections finish before removal
items.explanation: draining /ˈdreɪ.nɪŋ/ (danh từ): rút dần kết nối (chờ request cũ xong). Connection draining = ngừng nhận request mới, chờ request đang xử lý kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: draining /ˈdreɪ.nɪŋ/ (noun): letting existing connections finish before removal. Connection draining stops new requests and lets current ones finish.

items.question: Trong câu "Connection draining / Deregistration delay", từ "deregistration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Connection draining / Deregistration delay", what does "deregistration" (noun) mean?

optionsEn: removing something from a registered list
items.explanation: deregistration /diːˌredʒ.ɪˈstreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hủy đăng ký (gỡ khỏi nhóm). Deregistration = gỡ instance ra khỏi target group. Trái nghĩa: registration.
items.explanationEn: deregistration /diːˌredʒ.ɪˈstreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): removing something from a registered list. Deregistration removes an instance from the target group. Opposite: registration.

items.question: Trong câu "Connection draining / Deregistration delay", từ "delay" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: delay /dɪˈleɪ/ (noun): a period of waiting. Deregistration delay is the wait before fully removing an instance (default 300 s).

items.explanationEn: in-flight /ˌɪnˈflaɪt/ (adjective): currently in progress. In-flight requests are still being processed.

items.explanationEn: cooldown /ˈkuːl.daʊn/ (noun): a waiting period between actions. The cooldown period prevents scaling again too soon.

items.explanationEn: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (noun): a measured value, e.g. CPU usage. Metrics are measurements such as CPU or request count.

items.explanationEn: settle /ˈset̬.əl/ (verb): to become stable or calm. Letting metrics settle means waiting until they stabilize.

items.explanationEn: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (adjective): without stopping. Continuous scaling happens non-stop. Adverb: continuously.

items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɔːr.ə.taɪz/ (verb): to treat as more important first. Prioritizing AZ balancing means it comes first. Noun: priority.

items.explanationEn: customizable /ˈkʌs.tə.maɪ.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be changed to fit your needs. Customizable means you can change the termination policy. Verb: customize.

items.explanationEn: integration /ˌɪn.t̬əˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): connecting systems so they work together. ELB integration means ASG works together with ELB. Verb: integrate.

items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ɚ/ (verb): to cause something to start. Triggered by an alarm means the alarm starts it. Noun: trigger.

items.explanationEn: alarm /əˈlɑːrm/ (noun): an alert fired when a metric crosses a limit. A CloudWatch alarm fires when a metric crosses a threshold and triggers scaling.

items.explanationEn: breach /briːtʃ/ (verb): to go beyond a limit. A breached threshold has been crossed. Data breach = a data leak.

items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheduled: scale on a predefined schedule (time-predictable load).", what does "predefined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: predefined /ˌpriː.dɪˈfaɪnd/ (tính từ): được định sẵn từ trước. Predefined schedule = lịch đã đặt sẵn (vd. thứ Hai 9 giờ sáng).
items.explanationEn: predefined /ˌpriː.dɪˈfaɪnd/ (adjective): decided in advance. A predefined schedule is set in advance (e.g. Monday 9 AM).

items.question: Trong câu "Predictive: ML forecasts future load from history and scales ahead. Provision capacity before peak hours.", từ "predictive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Predictive: ML forecasts future load from history and scales ahead. Provision capacity before peak hours.", what does "predictive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: predictive /prɪˈdɪk.tɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính dự đoán. Predictive scaling = scale dựa trên dự đoán tải. Động từ: predict.
items.explanationEn: predictive /prɪˈdɪk.tɪv/ (adjective): based on predicting the future. Predictive scaling acts on predicted load. Verb: predict.

items.question: Trong câu "Predictive: ML forecasts future load from history and scales ahead. Provision capacity before peak hours.", từ "forecasts" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Predictive: ML forecasts future load from history and scales ahead. Provision capacity before peak hours.", what does "forecasts" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔːr.kæst/ (động từ): dự báo. ML forecasts future load = học máy dự báo tải tương lai từ lịch sử.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔːr.kæst/ (verb): to predict what will happen. ML forecasts future load from historical data.

items.question: Trong câu "Predictive: ML forecasts future load from history and scales ahead. Provision capacity before peak hours.", từ "peak" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Predictive: ML forecasts future load from history and scales ahead. Provision capacity before peak hours.", what does "peak" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: peak /piːk/ (tính từ): cao điểm. Peak hours = giờ cao điểm. Danh từ: a peak.
items.explanationEn: peak /piːk/ (adjective): the busiest or highest. Peak hours are the busiest times. Noun: a peak.

items.question: Trong câu "Scheduled fits when you know peak times in advance (e.g. business hours).", từ "fits" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheduled fits when you know peak times in advance (e.g. business hours).", what does "fits" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be the right clothing size
items.explanation: fit /fɪt/ (động từ): phù hợp. Scheduled fits when... = Scheduled phù hợp khi biết trước giờ cao điểm.
items.explanationEn: fit /fɪt/ (verb): to be suitable for. Scheduled fits when you already know the peak times.

items.question: Trong câu "Predictive fits cyclic-but-variable load, scaling proactively rather than reactively.", từ "cyclic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Predictive fits cyclic-but-variable load, scaling proactively rather than reactively.", what does "cyclic" (adjective) mean?
options: có tính chu kỳ, lặp lại
items.explanation: cyclic /ˈsaɪ.klɪk/ (tính từ): có tính chu kỳ, lặp lại. Cyclic load = tải lặp lại theo chu kỳ (ngày/tuần). Danh từ: cycle.
items.explanationEn: cyclic /ˈsaɪ.klɪk/ (adjective): repeating in regular cycles. Cyclic load repeats daily or weekly. Noun: cycle.

items.question: Trong câu "Predictive fits cyclic-but-variable load, scaling proactively rather than reactively.", từ "reactively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Predictive fits cyclic-but-variable load, scaling proactively rather than reactively.", what does "reactively" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách phản ứng (sau khi sự việc xảy ra)
items.explanation: reactively /riˈæk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): một cách phản ứng (sau khi sự việc xảy ra). Reactively = scale sau khi tải đã tăng; ngược với proactively.
items.explanationEn: reactively /riˈæk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): in response after something happens. Reactively means scaling after load rises; opposite: proactively.

items.question: Trong câu "You can combine policies; ASG scales to whichever policy demands the most capacity at that moment.", từ "whichever" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can combine policies; ASG scales to whichever policy demands the most capacity at that moment.", what does "whichever" (conjunction) mean?
options: bất kỳ cái nào (trong số đó)
optionsEn: any one of the options that
items.explanation: whichever /wɪˈtʃev.ɚ/ (liên từ): bất kỳ cái nào (trong số đó). Whichever policy demands the most = policy nào yêu cầu nhiều nhất thì theo policy đó.
items.explanationEn: whichever /wɪˈtʃev.ɚ/ (conjunction): any one of the options that. Whichever policy demands the most means ASG follows the one needing most capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "NLB = layer 4 (TCP/UDP), ultra-low latency, static IP / Elastic IP.", từ "ultra-low" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NLB = layer 4 (TCP/UDP), ultra-low latency, static IP / Elastic IP.", what does "ultra-low" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ultra-low /ˌʌl.trə ˈloʊ/ (tính từ): cực thấp. Ultra-low latency = độ trễ cực thấp. Tiền tố ultra- = cực kỳ.
items.explanationEn: ultra-low /ˌʌl.trə ˈloʊ/ (adjective): extremely low. Ultra-low latency is extremely low delay. Prefix ultra- = extremely.

items.question: Trong câu "Cross-zone differs by LB type (ALB always on/free; NLB off by default and charged).", từ "differs" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cross-zone differs by LB type (ALB always on/free; NLB off by default and charged).", what does "differs" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ɚ/ (động từ): khác nhau. Differs by LB type = khác nhau tùy loại LB. Tính từ: different.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ɚ/ (verb): to be not the same. Differs by LB type means it varies with the type. Adjective: different.

items.question: Trong câu "ASG: use ELB health checks to detect app failures, and cooldown to avoid rapid-fire scaling.", từ "rapid-fire" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ASG: use ELB health checks to detect app failures, and cooldown to avoid rapid-fire scaling.", what does "rapid-fire" (adjective) mean?
options: dồn dập, liên tiếp rất nhanh
items.explanation: rapid-fire /ˌræp.ɪd ˈfaɪr/ (tính từ): dồn dập, liên tiếp rất nhanh. Rapid-fire scaling = scale liên tục dồn dập; cooldown giúp tránh điều này.
items.explanationEn: rapid-fire /ˌræp.ɪd ˈfaɪr/ (adjective): happening quickly one after another. Rapid-fire scaling means very frequent scaling; cooldown prevents it.

items.question: Trong câu "Target Tracking = simplest; Predictive = proactive ML-based scaling.", từ "proactive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Target Tracking = simplest; Predictive = proactive ML-based scaling.", what does "proactive" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: acting in advance, before problems occur
items.explanation: proactive /ˌproʊˈæk.tɪv/ (tính từ): chủ động (hành động trước). Proactive scaling = scale trước khi tải tăng. Trái nghĩa: reactive.
items.explanationEn: proactive /ˌproʊˈæk.tɪv/ (adjective): acting in advance, before problems occur. Proactive scaling adds capacity before load rises. Opposite: reactive.

items.question: Trong câu "ASG spans multiple AZs for HA and automatically replaces unhealthy instances.", từ "spans" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ASG spans multiple AZs for HA and automatically replaces unhealthy instances.", what does "spans" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng qua, bao phủ. Spans multiple AZs = ASG trải qua nhiều AZ. Danh từ: span.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. Spans multiple AZs means it extends across several AZs. Noun: span.

items.question: Trong câu "ASG uses a launch template, configures min/desired/max, EC2/ELB health checks, and cooldown.", từ "configures" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ASG uses a launch template, configures min/desired/max, EC2/ELB health checks, and cooldown.", what does "configures" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set up options for a system
items.explanation: configure /kənˈfɪɡ.jɚ/ (động từ): cấu hình, thiết lập. Configures min/desired/max = thiết lập số instance tối thiểu/mong muốn/tối đa. Danh từ: configuration.
items.explanationEn: configure /kənˈfɪɡ.jɚ/ (verb): to set up options for a system. Configures min/desired/max means setting those capacity values. Noun: configuration.

items.question: Trong câu "HA principle: scale horizontally for load + multi-AZ for fault tolerance.", từ "principle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "HA principle: scale horizontally for load + multi-AZ for fault tolerance.", what does "principle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc. HA principle = nguyên tắc đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng cao. Đừng nhầm với principal.
items.explanationEn: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): a basic rule or idea. The HA principle is the basic rule for high availability. Don't confuse with principal.

items.question: Trong câu "HA principle: scale horizontally for load + multi-AZ for fault tolerance.", từ "horizontally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "HA principle: scale horizontally for load + multi-AZ for fault tolerance.", what does "horizontally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: horizontally /ˌhɔːr.əˈzɑːn.t̬əl.i/ (trạng từ): theo chiều ngang (thêm nhiều máy). Scale horizontally = thêm instance để xử lý tải. Tính từ: horizontal.
items.explanationEn: horizontally /ˌhɔːr.əˈzɑːn.t̬əl.i/ (adverb): by adding more machines. To scale horizontally is to add instances. Adjective: horizontal.
